column2: Provide a summary of the key learning objectives, focus areas, and planned activities across the week. This overview should outline how lessons connect to broader goals, highlight any special events or assessments, and support continuity in instruction. It serves as a snapshot for planning, collaboration, and communication.

This field ensures a cohesive and intentional plan that aligns goals, instruction, and evaluation in a meaningful way.
